WS_40K_CHAINSWORD.name: Chainsword
WS_40K_CHAINSWORD.description: Horizontal slash attack, hacks through enemies.

WS_40K_EVISCERATORCHAINSWORD.name: Eviscerator Chainsword
WS_40K_EVISCERATORCHAINSWORD.description: Evolved Chainsword. Slows and causes damage over time.

WS_40K_LASGUN.name: Lasgun
WS_40K_LASGUN.description: Shoots lasers at the nearest enemy. Damage decreases over distance.
WS_40K_LASGUN.customDescValue: Gain an additional follower with another Lasgun.

WS_40K_MELTAGUN.name: Meltagun
WS_40K_MELTAGUN.description: Extremely powerful, short-ranged beam, that deals double damage to close enemies. Deals bonus damage to bosses.

WS_40K_BOLTGUN.name: Boltgun
WS_40K_BOLTGUN.description: Fires bursts of exploding bolts in the faced direction.

WS_40K_HEAVY_BOLTER.name: Heavy Bolter
WS_40K_HEAVY_BOLTER.description: Evolved Boltgun. Lays down a constant barrage of suppressing fire.

WS_40K_SHIELD_OF_FAITH.name: Shield of Faith
WS_40K_SHIELD_OF_FAITH.description: Pulses a holy aura outwards, which knocks back and deals damage to enemies.
WS_40K_SHIELD_OF_FAITH.customDescValue: %0% chance to inflict minor burn on enemies.

WS_40K_EMPERORS_WRATH.name: Emperor's Wrath
WS_40K_EMPERORS_WRATH.description: A blazing aura of faith that scorches nearby foes with righteous vengeance and heals the bearer.

WS_40K_FLAMER.name: Flamer
WS_40K_FLAMER.description: Fires at a random enemy, deals heavy damage.

WS_40K_HEAVY_FLAMER.name: Heavy Flamer
WS_40K_HEAVY_FLAMER.description: Evolved Flamer. Fires twin-jets of burning promethium spreading fire to nearby foes.

WS_40K_HEAVY_FLAMER_EXPLOSION.name: Heavy Flamer Explosion
WS_40K_HEAVY_FLAMER_EXPLOSION.description: Evolved Flamer. Fires twin-jets of burning promethium spreading fire to nearby foes.

WS_40K_COMBAT_SHOTGUN.name: Combat Shotgun
WS_40K_COMBAT_SHOTGUN.description: Fires in a wide spread at short range.

WS_40K_ORBITAL_BOMBARDMENT.name: Orbital Bombardment
WS_40K_ORBITAL_BOMBARDMENT.description: Obliterates multiple targets with inescapable fury and leaves nothing but scorched ruin in its wake.

WS_40K_ORBITAL_BOMBARDMENT_BLAST.name: Orbital Bombardment
WS_40K_ORBITAL_BOMBARDMENT_BLAST.description: Obliterates multiple targets with inescapable fury and leaves nothing but scorched ruin in its wake.

WS_40K_ASTRA_MILITARUM_FRAG_GRENADE.description: Throws a grenade at a random enemy.

WS_40K_RIPPER_PISTOL.name: Ripper Pistol
WS_40K_RIPPER_PISTOL.description: Gift of Frag Grenade. Fires a burst of bullets. Poisons enemies.

WS_40K_REMOTE_DETONATION.name: Remote Detonation
WS_40K_REMOTE_DETONATION.description: Evolved Mechanical Bite. Adds an electrical explosion to the target area, Stuns enemies.

WS_40K_BALE_EYE.name: Bale Eye
WS_40K_BALE_EYE.description: An 'evil eye' implant that fires a devastating, short ranged laser which inflicts vulnerability on enemies. Inflicts Battle Shocked status to Orks.

WS_40K_WEAPON_OF_THE_MATRIARCH.name: Weapon of the Matriarch
WS_40K_WEAPON_OF_THE_MATRIARCH.description: Unleashes a burning horizontal strike of the Emperor’s wrath made manifest.

WS_40K_STORM_BOLTER.name: Storm Bolter
WS_40K_STORM_BOLTER.description: Fires quickly in four fixed directions.

WS_40K_ASSAULT_CANNON.name: Assault Cannon
WS_40K_ASSAULT_CANNON.description: Evolved Storm Bolter. Shots fire faster and faster until weapon overheats.

WS_40K_BATTLE_CANNON.name: Battle Cannon
WS_40K_BATTLE_CANNON.description: A high explosive shell that detonates on contact with an enemy or terrain.

WS_40K_SIDE_SPONSONS.name: Side Sponsons
WS_40K_SIDE_SPONSONS.description: Evolved Battle Cannon. Side-mounted Heavy Bolters.

WS_40K_PASK_SQUISH.name: Pask Squish
WS_40K_PASK_SQUISH.description: Tank is large, tank is heavy

WS_40K_BENEDICTION_OF_FURY.name: Benediction of Fury
WS_40K_BENEDICTION_OF_FURY.description: Evolved Crozius Arcanum. Strikes in front and behind, causing thunderous shockwaves.

WS_40K_FURY_OF_THE_ANCIENTS.name: Fury of the Ancients
WS_40K_FURY_OF_THE_ANCIENTS.description: An evolution of Smite, unique to Mephiston. Shoots a beam of warp-infused energy that damages all enemies in its path.

WS_40K_RELIQUARY.name: Reliquary
WS_40K_RELIQUARY.description: Gift of Archeotech. Choose any unlocked evolved weapon.

WS_40K_FIDELIS.name: Fidelis
WS_40K_FIDELIS.description: Short range bolter that shoots below character. Emits light as projectiles expire.

WS_40K_DEATHSTRIKE_MISSILE.name: Deathstrike Missile
WS_40K_DEATHSTRIKE_MISSILE.description: Evolved Storm Eagle Rocket. Annihilates enemies, accumulates bonus XP.

WS_40K_DA_LUCKY_STIKK.name: Da Lucky Stikk
WS_40K_DA_LUCKY_STIKK.description: Improves Chance but also increases Bait.

WS_40K_CODEX_ASTARTES.name: Codex Astartes
WS_40K_CODEX_ASTARTES.description: Improves Attacks, Redeployment and reduces Corruption.

WS_AOS_BRACE_OF_PISTOLS.name: Brace of Pistols
WS_AOS_BRACE_OF_PISTOLS.description: Rapidly fires a stream of projectiles at the nearest enemy.

WS_AOS_DUELLING_PISTOLS.name: Duelling Pistols
WS_AOS_DUELLING_PISTOLS.description: Evolved Brace of Pistols. Projectiles can fragment and make enemies Vulnerable.

WS_AOS_NEBULOUS_SEAFOG.name: Lorai Fog
WS_AOS_NEBULOUS_SEAFOG.description: Glimmers with strange light, sapping the strength of foes who enter its embrace.

WS_AOS_AQUATIC_ILLUSIONS.name: Aquatic Illusions
WS_AOS_AQUATIC_ILLUSIONS.description: Constant damaging aura that slows enemies. Periodically summons illusions that pull enemies into the aura and trigger retaliatory damage.

WS_AOS_FUSIL_CANNON.name: Fusil-Cannon
WS_AOS_FUSIL_CANNON.description: A shield that blocks enemies reaching the player and fires bullers in the face direction.

WS_AOS_LONG_FUSIL.name: Long-Fusil
WS_AOS_LONG_FUSIL.description: The Major shoots at the nearest enemy and the Warhulk smashes the ground with his shield.

WS_AOS_TYPHOON_CROSSBOW.name: Typhoon Crossbow
WS_AOS_TYPHOON_CROSSBOW.description: Evolved Boltstorm Pistol. Fires with no delay.

WS_AOS_GRANDBLADE.name: Grandblade
WS_AOS_GRANDBLADE.customDescValue: Every fourth activation has a combo finisher.

WS_AOS_CYCLONE_SWORD.name: Cyclone Sword
WS_AOS_CYCLONE_SWORD.description: A sword swept along by a powerful gust of wind, targeting enemies before returning to the wielder.
WS_AOS_CYCLONE_SWORD.customDescValue: Chance to inflict Stunned status up by %0%.

WS_AOS_VOICE_OF_THE_GOD_KING.name: Voice of the God-King
WS_AOS_VOICE_OF_THE_GOD_KING.description: Gift of Cyclone Sword which can recharge this weapon, triggering a divine lightning strike.

WS_AOS_VOICE_OF_THE_GOD_KING_DAMAGE_ZONE.name: Voice of the God-King - Damage Zone

WS_AOS_FYRESLAYER_AXE.name: Fyrestorm Greataxe
WS_AOS_FYRESLAYER_AXE.description: Summons an axe that swings as the player moves.

WS_AOS_ZANGROM_THAZ.name: Zangrom-Thaz
WS_AOS_ZANGROM_THAZ.description: Summons an axe that swings as the player moves.

WS_AOS_USKAVAR_THE_SUNDERER.name: Uskavar the Sunderer
WS_AOS_USKAVAR_THE_SUNDERER.description: PLACEHOLDER. The hammer of Lord-Commander Bastian Carthalos.

WS_AOS_MASTER_OF_RUNES.name: Master of Runes
WS_AOS_MASTER_OF_RUNES.description: Evolved Brazier Staff. Arcing molten rock projectiles explode on the ground, inflicting Burning on enemies in a wide area.

WS_AOS_TWIN_TAILED_CAT.name: Twin-Tailed Cat
WS_AOS_TWIN_TAILED_CAT.description: Summons little watchers that attack enemies and might interact with pickups.

WS_AOS_ENCHANTED_GLOVE.name: Enchanted Glove
WS_AOS_ENCHANTED_GLOVE.description: Evolved Twin-Tailed Cat. ‘Little Watchers’ dash around and collect items which provide positive effects for the player.

WS_AOS_BLADE_OF_THE_HIGH_HEAVENS.name: Blade Of the High Heavens
WS_AOS_BLADE_OF_THE_HIGH_HEAVENS.description: Powerful slashes in front and behind. Grants Blessed when defeating many enemies.
WS_AOS_BLADE_OF_THE_HIGH_HEAVENS.customDescValue: Increased chance of scoring critical hits with the blade tip.

WS_AOS_POISONED_THROWING_KNIVES.name: Poisoned Throwing Knives
WS_AOS_POISONED_THROWING_KNIVES.description: Throws a blade projectile that might bounce off enemies and inflict Poisoned.

WS_AOS_MYSTICAL_WARD.name: Mystical Ward
WS_AOS_MYSTICAL_WARD.description: Blocks damage with a mystical ward that deals retaliatory damage when struck.

WS_AOS_WARDING_LANTERN.name: Warding Lantern
WS_AOS_WARDING_LANTERN.description: Blocks damage with up to 3 divine wards that deal retaliatory damage. When all wards are lost, releases a holy explosion that burns and spreads fire among nearby enemies.

WS_AOS_MASTER_RUNE.name: Master Rune
WS_AOS_MASTER_RUNE.description: Kragg Blackhammer's Master Rune. All held passives gain +1 level.

WS_AOS_NULL_PENDANT.name: Null Pendant
WS_AOS_NULL_PENDANT.description: Enemies tagged as Manifestation or Endless spell do 10% less damage

WS_AOS_QUICKSILVER_SWORDS.name: Quicksilver Swords
WS_AOS_QUICKSILVER_SWORDS.description: Blades that slice through the air and lock in on nearby enemies.

WS_SAVES.name: Glue
WS_SAVES.description: Reduces incoming Damage by 1. Increases retaliatory Damage by 10%.

WS_SUSTAIN.name: Hourglass
WS_SUSTAIN.description: Increases duration of weapon effects by 10%.

WS_AURA.name: Bar Magnet
WS_AURA.description: Character picks up items from further away.

WS_CORRUPTION.name: Chaos Sigil
WS_CORRUPTION.description: Increases enemy speed, health, quantity, and frequency by 10%.

WS_MORDANT_EARTH.name: Mordant Earth
WS_MORDANT_EARTH.description: Evolved Nuln Oil. Damaging zones follow you and slow enemies.

WS_D6_DICE.name: D6 Dice
WS_D6_DICE.description: Throws exploding dice. Damage is based on the number rolled. Increase Blessing to roll better.

WS_ABILITY.name: Tactical Rock
WS_ABILITY.description: Display your heroism and increase your Strength, Skill, Sustain, and Aura. Attracts tougher enemies.
